file_header.name: F-16 Subsonic Aerodynamics Model (a la Garza)

description.value:
F-16 aero data file. Based on Morelli's adaptation of Stevens and Lewis' F-16 example [1] described in Garza &
      Morelli's TM [2]. Obtained from E. A. Morelli in the form of Matlab scripts [3] & [4].

reference.author: Stevens, Brian L. and Lewis, Frank L.
reference.title: Aircraft Control and Simulation

reference.author: Garza, Fredrico R.; and Morelli, Eugene A.
reference.title: A Collection of Nonlinear Aircraft Simulations in MATLAB

description.value:
From E. A. Morelli's f16 matlab script, dated 09-Oct-2000;
        Generated using 'make_DAVEML_checkcases.m'

Added checkcase static shots and internal values for debugging
        purposes.

Corrected to DAVEfunc.dtd 1.9 standards: replaced xns with email; corrected dates to ANSI; replaced docIC with
        refID in documentRefs; added fileVersion element

Resorted variableDefs so they appear in proper order, in
        response to bug report from Giovanni Cignoni. Reindented file using emacs nxml-mode.

Updated to DAVE-ML 2.0: replaced fileCreationDate and functionCreationDate with new creationDate element;
        changed to my email alias.
Updated to DAVE-ML 2.0: replaced signalID elements with varID elements in checkcase data.
Updated to new AIAA standard variable names.

Corrected description of MRC x-location constant; updated to Jan 10 S-119 units-of-measure encoding. Renamed
        deprecated griddedTables to griddedTableDefs.

Hopefully this time I fixed the problems with internal variable values for positive and negative pitch rate
        check cases, and with names of yaw rate check cases, originally cited by Trey Arthur and re-discovered by Missy
        Hill. Untabified (all whitespace are now spaces, not tabs for easier viewing in any text editor

Removed auto revision field, since we're now under git. Added xmlns attribute to DAVEfunc to conform to DTD 2,
        RC3.

Added namespace to <math> elements, xmlns attribute to DAVEfunc, and gtIDs to conform to DTD 2.0 RC4;
        corrected PUBLIC ID string.
Corrected systemID in DOCTYPE to include full formal URL to 2p0 DAVEfunc.dtd

Added explicit isInput tags to input variables per now-standard practice; added minValue attribute to true
	airspeed to avoid divide-by-zero in calculations.

Marked reference area, span and chord as outputs; changed all length units from "f" to "ft" to match final S-119
	convention.

Changed axis prefix of CG and MRC position parameters from "body" to "vrs" to reflect convention that these are
	positive aft; added explicit 'sign' attribute to CG position input variable.

Removed 'vrsPositionOfCgWrtWingLeadingEdge_X' input to better conform to convention; thus, moment coefficients
	are given about the moment reference center (35 % mean aero chord). This means moment transfers to the center of
	mass must be done externally to this routine. Also modified the embedded F-16 matlab script as it no longer
	matches, as it had the moment transfer calculations. Updated descriptions of coefficient outputs to state they
	are acting at or about the moment reference center.

Replaced 'vt_unlim' internal variable in checkcase data sets with just 'vt', thanks to alert users Mike Madden
	and Jeremy Schidner.
